g.text: Rivian spinout Also was working on an e-moto project in Kenya — until it walked away ◆ Google will let schools disable its AI tools, but not without sacrificing Search ◆ New York City’s Mamdani criticizes Madison Square Garden owner over surveillance tech ◆ Apple restricts dating apps and AI companions to users 18 and up ◆ The TechCrunch Founder Summit agenda is only half the reason to be in Boston on Nov. 4 ◆ Tomorrow: TechCrunch Founder Summit takes over Boston and when pass rates increase ◆
